# Is your Lambda memory setting costing you money?

> Paste AWS Lambda CloudWatch REPORT lines and see peak memory against what you configured, duration percentiles, cold-start share, and the memory size that minimises cost without a latency regression. Free, runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
